name: Haniwa
description:
Haniwa are peculiar creatures made of living clay. They once ruled a glorious kingdom, but when the land rose from the sea they were cut off from the clay deposits, and what is left is a race of nomadic raiders.

The ceramic body shrugs off fire, lightning, and magic, and it shatters under a hard hit. Deep water softens it, a crack heals slowly, and the hollow chest can still throw a sonic boom.
